procedure_name: Illustrative report retention and grouping procedure
time_order: This rule was introduced on 6 October 2026 after the draft already cited 49 of the frozen 242 PRISMA-included primary reports; it documents their retention and grouping, not how the earlier choice was made.
uniform_documentary_access_tests: Resolve the included canonical ID and frozen row.
Resolve source hashes and existing evidence IDs/page-or-section locators; verify a local-copy hash when found.
Preserve concrete operation/mechanism/condition text, original status and explicit missingness.
Keep report evaluation scope and each local study entry; do not impute missing study classifications or independent cohorts.
current_illustration_retention_tests: Nominate a precise fact in a current cited context, separating it from general design implications.
Inspect available primary text and record the factual correspondence, source SHA, existing evidence IDs and exact page scope; a token/locator match alone is insufficient.
Retain only for an explicit documentary operation/condition, qualified contrast, boundary/null outcome, companion/demo distinction or historical purpose.
Preserve material relevant qualifications identified in the inspected scope; favorable and contrary cases use the same source/version requirement.
State the distinct purpose relative to named overlapping examples; unresolved evidence or redundancy requires source review, even for an existing citation.

narrative_roles.principal: Documentary anchor for a precise operation, mechanism, access condition or evidence unit; no best/typical/effective verdict.
narrative_roles.contrasting: A named descriptive difference in operations, assumptions, tasks or designs; no superiority or causal verdict.
narrative_roles.boundary: A material limitation, contrary/null outcome, missing measurement or scope condition qualifying interpretation.
narrative_roles.demo: A demonstrated example or companion implementation, without inferring a new independent study or cohort.
narrative_roles.historical: Source-located background for an earlier operation/configuration; dates do not establish improvement.

disposition_definitions.retained_current_illustration_scoped: Retained for the nominated fact-context pair and stated purpose only; not all report claims or conclusions.
disposition_definitions.current_illustration_needs_source_review: A current illustration has an insufficient/inconsistent nominated source basis or unresolved retention redundancy.
disposition_definitions.not_selected_current_unresolved: Uncited included alternative; no present fact nominated or comparative retention judgement performed.

comparison_basis: Descriptive contrasts can explain differing operations/tasks/assumptions. Outcome comparisons must preserve task, population, comparator, measure/unit and conditions; without established compatibility use a boundary case rather than a comparative effect.
grouping_basis: The five existing RQs and exact existing map groups/codes/statuses are candidate pools only. Their membership does not prove compatibility or claim support.
amendment_rule: Any additional/removed illustration needs a dated record of the nominated fact, source-target result, distinct purpose and qualification/overlap basis; no numerical quota or favorable-outcome requirement.
limits: Targeted documentary inspection, not an independent human appraisal or full-text reading attestation.
The 193 alternatives remain unresolved; the 49 are not claimed to be minimal or optimal.
All other citation facts and synthesis conclusions remain outside these nominated checks unless separately listed.
No quality rating, expertise inference, effect pooling, causal comparison or new corpus.

original_inspection_basis.scope: The original targeted inspection concerns 49 nominated fact-context pairs. Current source bindings relocate those exact unchanged paragraphs; no new primary inspection is claimed.

applied_summary.scope: These are audit/documentary counts; they do not establish all-citation factual verification, optimal selection, full-text reading, independence or effectiveness.
